subject.title: fix(telegram): add renderMode config to skip HTML rendering on macOS

question: Should OpenClaw accept an account-wide Telegram `renderMode: raw` config as the fix shape for the macOS rendering issue, or should this PR be retargeted to the specific `/model` and `/commands` rendering paths?
rationale: The PR adds user-facing config surface and only partially wires it, while repository policy sets a high bar for new config options and the reported bug is limited to specific Telegram UI surfaces.

options.title: Retarget without new config
options.body: Drop the account-wide render mode and patch the actual command/model rendering path with focused Telegram Desktop proof.

options.title: Complete raw-mode config
options.body: Keep the new option only if it is threaded through direct sends, replies, callback edits, generated metadata, docs/tests, and Telegram Desktop proof.

options.title: Hold behind canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR blocked while maintainers decide whether the canonical issue should be solved by config or renderer repair.

recommendation.title: Retarget without new config
recommendation.body: Drop the account-wide render mode and patch the actual command/model rendering path with focused Telegram Desktop proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent follow-up history on the Telegram rich-message gate and are the best available routing owner for the config/product-shape decision.
